sloka: रक्षाम्सि वक्षाम्सि च विक्षिपन्ति ।गात्राणि कान्तासु च विक्षिपन्ति ।रूपाअणि चित्राणि च विक्षिपन्ति ।दृढानि चापानि च विक्षिपन्ति ॥५-५-१२॥
transliteration: rakṣāmsi vakṣāmsi ca vikṣipanti ।gātrāṇi kāntāsu ca vikṣipanti ।rūpāaṇi citrāṇi ca vikṣipanti ।dṛḍhāni cāpāni ca vikṣipanti ॥5-5-12॥

translations.english: The demons were seen expanding their chests sportively and caressing their wives by placing their limbs on them. They were assuming wonderful forms, and drawing their bows up to their ears.
